name: not_2p56m
label: Nordic Optical Telescope 2.56 m
sources: NOT technical details (not.iac.es/telescope/tti/technical-details.html): primary 2560 mm Zerodur f/2, (Super) Ritchey-Chretien, system focal length 28160 mm (f/11), focal-plane scale 7.33 arcsec/mm, altitude-azimuth mount, 30 arcmin field; GPS position 28 45 26.2 N, 17 53 06.3 W, 2382 m
notes: Throughput 0.3 (atmosphere + telescope optics to the camera, excl. filter and PDE) is the hbtsim default, not an LPQI number; Prada et al. 2026 (ELTI) adopt an overall instrumental efficiency of 0.5 for a SPAD camera at the focus.
Plate scale 0.18 arcsec per 24.5 um pixel at the f/11 focus (the Sensors paper's figure follows from the 28.16 m focal length).
